semiconductor_relevance: High — Manz specializes in semiconductor equipment and solutions, particularly in advanced packaging and IC substrate processing.
summary: Manz Asia provides advanced semiconductor equipment and solutions, focusing on wet chemistry, plating, and automation technologies. Their offerings include production-proven electrochemical deposition platforms and integrated wet process tools, supporting high-density packaging and substrate processing from R&D to high-volume manufacturing.
capabilities: Electrochemical deposition (ECD) platforms for panel formats of 310 mm, 510 mm, and 700 mm
Integrated wet process tools including cleaning, developing, etching, and stripping
Advanced packaging solutions for high-density interconnects
Contract manufacturing services for semiconductor equipment

regional_presence.Taiwan: Manz Asia operates in Taoyuan, Taiwan, focusing on advanced packaging equipment and process solutions.
